This Study Uses Audio

Each design phase includes the designer thinking out loud. Their voice will be played as audio while the text appears on screen.

Please note:

  • Use headphones or speakers in a quiet environment.
  • Listen to the full think-aloud in every phase — you cannot move to the next phase until the audio has finished playing.
  • You can replay the audio at any time with the 🔊 Replay button.

Welcome to the Design Process Evaluation Study

You will review real design-process records from your own design domain. For each phase you'll diagnose what kind of block the designer faced, judge how believable the process is, and rate its quality.

What You'll Do:

  • Review design projects from your domain, one project at a time
  • Watch each phase's think-aloud, then answer a short set of questions
  • Diagnose the kind of block, judge believability and process quality
  • Give a whole-project judgment at the end of each project

Kinds of Block a Designer May Face

As you evaluate each phase, you'll judge which of these the designer was dealing with. A phase may involve more than one — no label is shown to you.

Ambiguity

Multiple Interpretations

The brief or situation can be read in several valid but conflicting ways.

Vagueness

Unclear Boundaries

It's a matter of degree — where exactly to draw the line is fuzzy.

Uncertainty

Insufficient Information

A specific fact is missing or unknowable, so the outcome can't be predicted.

Tacit Knowledge

Acting on Feel

The designer accepts or rejects on feel, without a stated reason.
